en: Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a panoramic view over a town in a hilly landscape. In the foreground there are rocks and trees, behind them a large multi-storey sanatorium-like building with towers and chimneys on the left, and a compact town with steep-roofed houses and a church or clock tower in the middle distance. Rolling hills and fields stretch into the background. Printed German text appears at the top left of the image.
